global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and crisp nori seaweed. A watermelon slice and bean sprouts garnish the noodles in a white bowl with red geometric trim, set against a warm wooden background under soft, inviting light.

regions.background: The table surface appears smooth, light brown wood grain with subtle texture and soft highlights.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red geometric patterned rim, smooth surface, circular shape, slightly raised edge.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, garnished with watermelon, green onions, and a dark, textured topping.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, slightly glossy surface and rounded, tapered shape.
regions.seaweed: Nori seaweed, dark green and textured, appears as a rectangular strip with uneven, slightly curled edges and visible grainy surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: browned, textured, rectangular slice with visible fat marbling and slightly charred surface.
